data.body: Landed: Gerrit change 1922 MERGED to main with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments. Closing as preexisting — the janitor's DEFAULT_FREE_WATERMARK_BYTES = 2 GiB absolute floor was disk-size-blind from the outset and only became reachable as a latent defect once the review-bot's 30 GiB root made 2 GiB free equal 93.3% used, above both the 85% alarm and the 90% peak. Not a regression: nothing changed to break it. The three siblings (smart-disloyal-naga for the ~620 MiB-per-review ticket-tree copy, itchy-arbored-peccary for the missing byte-total backstop, uninspired-gabardine-pilchard for the unpublished AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker) carry the remaining work and are linked.
